settings.name: How tasks work
settings.about: Each new task's brief ends with these in its Settings block, each as the line shown. To change one for a single task, tell its coordinator.

rows.label: Review
rows.line: Review: on. Have your change reviewed by fresh eyes before it merges.

rows.label: Must fix
rows.line: Must fix: major. Findings are tagged critical/major/minor/trivial; fix critical and major, then review again.

rows.label: Review rounds
rows.line: Review rounds: 3. Stop when a round finds none to fix, at most 3 rounds.

rows.label: Merge
rows.line: Merge: on its own. Merge it yourself once it works (shepherdr merge <id>). Don't wait for GitHub's checks.

rows.label: Agent
rows.line: Reviewer: a headless Codex or a Codex subagent (its default model and effort).

settings.note:
